title: dial params
description: Connects to a remote kamune server. Which fields are required depends on transport: addr for tcp and udp, relay_addr and token for relay, broker_addr and p2p_token for p2p, and direct_peer_addr for direct-p2p. Over a relay, connecting to the relay and the relay handshake are limited to 15 seconds.

addr.description: Server address (e.g. "127.0.0.1:9000"). Required for tcp and udp, where an empty addr fails with addr_required. Ignored for relay, p2p and direct-p2p.

transport.description: Transport protocol. Defaults to "tcp" when empty or absent. Any other value fails with invalid_transport.

relay_addr.description: Relay server address, host:port with an optional scheme: wss:// (the default), tls://, ws:// or tcp://. A trailing ?insecure=true turns off TLS certificate checks; for a relay with a self-signed certificate use relay_pin instead. ws://, tcp:// and ?insecure=true let an on-path attacker read the relay password and tokens, and are logged as a warning. Required when transport is "relay".

relay_pin.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the relay's TLS certificate, as 64 hex digits, optionally separated by colons as openssl prints it; the relay logs it at startup. With it, a wss or tls relay must have exactly that certificate, which takes the place of the checks against the system's roots and the relay's name, so a relay with a self-signed certificate can be reached without turning the checks off. A pin for a ws or tcp relay, together with ?insecure=true, or that is not a SHA-256 digest fails with invalid_relay_pin. Used only when transport is "relay".

token.description: Hex-encoded relay token. Required when transport is "relay".

name.description: Client display name. Defaults to a fingerprint pseudonym, which incognito mode always uses. A name longer than 64 bytes, or with a control, format, line separator or paragraph separator character, such as a line break, a bidirectional control or a zero-width space, fails with invalid_name; the zero-width joiner and non-joiner are allowed.

broker_addr.description: UDP host:port of the broker. Required when transport is "p2p".

peer_pub_b64.description: Base64-encoded public key of the peer to reach, as list_peers gives it. When set, the session must reach exactly that key: a peer with another key is rejected before it is verified or asked about, whatever name it claims, and the dial fails with peer_key_mismatch. Reconnects of a dialed session are always held to the key of its peer. A key that is not a valid Ed25519 key fails with invalid_peer_key. Set it whenever the dial is meant for a known peer, above all on a static relay or p2p token: such a token is a hash of both peers' public keys, so anyone who knows them can answer it.

p2p_token.description: Hex-encoded P2P token from the server: 32 hex characters for a token the broker assigned, 64 for a static token. Required when transport is "p2p", where any other value fails with invalid_p2p_token. The dial waits at most 30 seconds for the broker to match it with the server.

direct_peer_addr.description: UDP host:port of the peer. Required when transport is "direct-p2p".
